answers.answer: The prohibition regulates any person maintaining, servicing, repairing, or disposing of an appliance or industrial process refrigeration. The prohibited conduct is knowingly venting or otherwise releasing into the environment any refrigerant from such appliances, subject to the exemption for specific substitutes in specific end-uses.
